_notes: Round three (React Bits + GSAP islands, ~138 KB gz JS by decision, GSAP-only): perf ≥ 90 and TBT ≤ 200 ms on simulated slow-4G/4× CPU; measured 95–96 / 0–10 ms after deferring the dot-grid physics and menu hydration to idle. LCP is warn-only (lantern variance).

CLS: every image is sized. src/styles/font-fallbacks.css metric-matches Georgia/Arial/Helvetica Neue, giving 0 on Windows, macOS and iOS (measured 0 on 9/9 local runs). The Ubuntu CI runner has none of those fonts, so its swap shift is ≤ 0.02; anything above that is a layout bug.
Landing JS (≤ 55 KB gz), font count (≤ 4) and image sizes are enforced separately by scripts/check-assets.mjs at build time.
